archetype: Archetype 4/5 Hybrid (Swiss & High-Contrast / Jewel & Luxury - Premium Black & Gray)

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use negative space to create a premium, unhurried feel.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol / Control Room Grid for dashboards with gap-6 or gap-8. Do not pack items too tightly.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements. Soft curves balance the dark/harsh theme.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #27272A (border-zinc-800) for all cards and interactive surfaces.

components_instructions.sidebar: Minimalist sidebar. Background: transparent or #050505. Use a simple border-r border-zinc-800. Links must have high contrast hover states (text-white, bg-zinc-900).
components_instructions.dashboard_cards: Flat cards, bg-zinc-900/50, border border-zinc-800, rounded-2xl. Massive numbers for metrics (e.g., text-5xl font-light).
components_instructions.project_cards: Image takes 60% of card height. Minimal text below. Subtle scale-up on image hover. Status badge in absolute position over image.
components_instructions.immersive_viewer: Simulated 360 viewer. Full viewport height area or large 16:9 container. Use the panoramic interior image. Controls (zoom, fullscreen) overlay with backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 and border-white/10.
components_instructions.buttons: Primary: pure white bg, black text, rounded-full or rounded-xl. Hover: scale down slightly (active:scale-95) and bg-zinc-200. Secondary: transparent, white border. NEVER use primary color heavily, keep it monochrome.
components_instructions.tables_lists: Clean lists for images. Use Shadcn Table or flexbox rows with border-b border-zinc-800. Padding p-4.
components_instructions.navigation: Breadcrumbs or top header with current page title. Simple, unpolluted.
components_instructions.forms: Inputs with bg-zinc-900, border-zinc-800, text-white, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white.
components_instructions.public_sharing_pages: Must be 100% clean, immersive. No sidebar, no admin navigation. Just the project title, cover/viewer, and a clean 'Powered by FIVI360' branding.
components_instructions.settings_and_plans: Settings page: simple forms with dark inputs. Plans page: High-contrast pricing cards. The selected plan card should have a white border.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down on click (active:scale-95). Images slightly zoom on card hover.

icons.style: Light weight, clean. text-zinc-400 default, text-white on hover.
